plans.ligne: I'm literally an AI setter, and I'm begging you: do not fire your human setter.
plans.jeu: Walking selfie, frustrated and urgent, high energy: free hand pressed toward the lens pleading on 'begging you', shaking slightly, then a sharp index finger jab at the camera on 'do not fire', eyebrows high, jaw tense, intense eyes, constant micro-movements.

flow.note: 1er essai refusé par Flow (« prominent people », faux positif, remboursé) ; 2e essai sans le prénom dans le prompt : OK

plans.ligne_gardee: do not fire your human setter.

plans.ligne: Look, every ad says fire your setter for AI. AI takes the 11 p.m. "how much", your human takes the calls. That's why we built ManySetter.
plans.jeu: [0-1 s] stops abruptly, quick breath, brings the phone closer. [1-3 s] eye roll on 'every ad', glance away then back. [3-6 s] counts on his fingers on '11 p.m.', firm hand chop on 'takes the calls'. [6-8 s] leans in, confident half smile.
plans.prompt_veo:
Vertical 9:16 iPhone front camera selfie, UGC style, handheld at arm's length with slight natural hand shake. The man from the start frame walks down his apartment hallway, soft daylight from a window behind the phone, a bright doorway far behind him, background soft and barely readable. Natural skin with visible pores, a slight shine on his forehead, light freckles.
[00:00-00:01] He stops abruptly, takes a quick breath and brings the phone closer to his face, fed up and urgent.
[00:01-00:03] He rolls his eyes and says: "Look, every ad says fire your setter for AI." His eyes flick away for a split second, then back to the lens.
[00:03-00:06] Counting on his fingers, then a firm hand chop: "AI takes the 11 p.m. 'how much', your human takes the calls."
[00:06-00:08] He leans in with a confident half smile: "That's why we built ManySetter."
Voice: warm American male voice, mid-low pitch, projects his voice like a creator talking to his phone, fast and casual, like a voice note to a friend, no long pauses.
SFX: his sneakers squeak on the wooden floor as he stops.
Ambient noise: quiet apartment room tone, faint city traffic through an open window.
One continuous take, no cuts. Clean frame with nothing written on screen.
